name: dsh-compaction-basic-fixed
description: Stable loader for the DeepSeek Harness compaction backend: picks the re-based long-session copy matching the installed dsh-compaction-basic, falls back to the shipped package otherwise, and overlays the live compaction-threshold setting (compact at N% of the model's context window).

dsh.compatibilityNote: engines.dsh decides alone (dsh-app-boot evaluatePluginCompatibility); the version-pinned peerDependencies live in versions/<v>/package.json and are gated by index.mjs at import time, never by the preflight.
